note: raw_accel_sensor / raw_gyro_sensor are PRE axis-remap (raw sensor frame) and are the source of truth. raw_accel_canonical / raw_gyro_canonical are post-remap (what the live pipeline consumed). Reprocess from *_sensor if axisMap is wrong. packetVersionBySensor is the IMU packet format version, NOT the firmware version (see firmwareBuildTag). cycles[] carries per-cycle ZUPT diagnostics (zuptCheck: vStartPreDrift/vEndPreDrift/windowSource/zuptAccelDeviationG) for every gait cycle seen during the recording, not just the last one.
